title: Franchise Hype Index
subtitle: A daily attention board for games, anime, films, toys, and story worlds that keep turning into internet events.

cityPreview.summary: Wikipedia attention for fandom franchises across games, anime, films, toys, and story worlds.

confidence: Observed daily English Wikipedia article pageviews through 2026-08-31.
methodology: This story is generated from the Wikimedia Pageviews API for selected high-interest English Wikipedia articles. Values are daily all-access, user-agent-filtered pageviews. The story publishes a render-ready projection and keeps raw API responses out of the public payload.
